'''Picador Group''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that fielded [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]] armed with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons for use in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] against capital ships. The fighter group was named after either [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Picador/Legends|picadors]] - drones who had the prestigious position of maintaining control in the [[Petranaki arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] - or the [[Static pike/Legends|Picador's spear]], a weapon from the Geonosian martial arts form of [[Petranaki/Legends|Petranaki]].
